input.overview: For {duration}, the shop answered shoppers more slowly than usual. A software update changed how the shop works out a shopper's average spend per item: for each past purchase, it added up all of the shopper's past purchases again. That meant the more a shopper had bought, the more work each page took, so shoppers with longer purchase histories were hit hardest. Argus estimates the shop lost {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody on call was paged. Argus rolled back the update, and the rollback is confirmed and still in place. Automatic syncing has been left off so the update isn't reapplied. Argus has also proposed a permanent fix, but it is still a draft and hasn't been put into use.
